traps.title: Tickle Monster on Jhin
traps.theory: Tickle Monster turns Attack Damage into Attack Speed, and Jhin's Whisper turns Attack Speed into Attack Damage. On paper each one keeps raising the other, so Jhin's damage grows without end.
traps.practice: It doesn't run away. The two bonuses don't keep feeding each other, so Jhin ends up with a modest bump to Attack Damage instead of infinite damage. Jhin also hasn't been seen getting Tickle Monster this patch.

bugs.title: ADAPt + escAPADe
bugs.theory: ADAPt turns Attack Damage into Ability Power, and escAPADe turns Ability Power into Attack Damage. On paper each one keeps raising the other, so Attack Damage grows without end.
bugs.test: Take ADAPt and escAPADe, then open your stats after each item. If Attack Damage keeps climbing on its own, it's a bug worth reporting. If it settles after one step, it's a trap.

bugs.title: Lich Brain on Vladimir
bugs.theory: Vladimir's Crimson Pact turns Ability Power into Health, and Lich Brain turns Health into Ability Power. On paper each one keeps raising the other, so Ability Power grows without end.
bugs.test: Take Lich Brain on Vladimir, then open your stats after each item. If Ability Power keeps climbing on its own, it's a bug worth reporting. If it settles after one step, it's a trap.

bugs.title: Purist - Caster + Tap Dancer + With Haste
bugs.theory: With Haste turns Ability Haste into Move Speed, Tap Dancer turns Move Speed into Attack Speed, and Purist - Caster turns Attack Speed into Ability Haste. On paper each one keeps raising the other, so Ability Haste grows without end.
bugs.test: Take Purist - Caster and Tap Dancer and With Haste, then open your stats after each item. If Ability Haste keeps climbing on its own, it's a bug worth reporting. If it settles after one step, it's a trap.
